slides.title: Motion Studio
slides.subtitle: Presentations, scripts and motion-graphics video from a single spec
slides.narration: Welcome to Motion Studio. One deck file becomes a slide deck, a narration script, and a fully animated video.

slides.title: One source, every format

bullets.sub: Slides, script and video stay in sync
Every layout animates in with spring physics
Native PowerPoint with real charts and speaker notes

slides.narration: Instead of maintaining a deck, a script and a video separately, you write the story once. Every layout animates in automatically, and the PowerPoint export stays fully editable.

slides.title: Fast by design
slides.narration: There are eleven animated layouts, five output formats, and narration in thirty-one languages with Supertonic.

slides.title: Charts that draw themselves
slides.caption: Sample data
slides.narration: Charts are defined as data, animate on screen, and export as native, editable PowerPoint charts.

slides.title: Before and after
slides.narration: Before, a talk meant three tools and a lot of manual re-timing. Now it is one file, and timing adapts to the narration automatically.

slides.title: How a deck gets made
slides.narration: The workflow is simple: a brief, an outline, a script, and then a render.

slides.title: Render everything
slides.code:
# preview slides as images
motionstudio stills deck.json

# narrate with open-source TTS
motionstudio tts deck.json

# video, HTML, PPTX, PDF and script
motionstudio render deck.json
slides.narration: Three commands cover it: preview stills, generate narration, and render every format.

slides.text: The best presentation is the one your audience remembers.
slides.narration: Because in the end, the best presentation is the one your audience remembers.

slides.title: Thank you
slides.subtitle: Made with Motion Studio
slides.narration: Thanks for watching. Now go make something memorable.
